title: Data Analyst
desc: Function Finance Our Company We’re Hitachi Vantara, the data foundation trusted by the world’s innovators. Our resilient, high-performance data infrastructure means that customers – from banks to theme parks ­– can focus on achieving the incredible with data. If you’ve seen the Las Vegas Sphere, you’ve seen just one example of how we empower businesses to automate, optimize, innovate – and wow their customers. Right now, we’re laying the foundation for our next wave of growth. We’re looking for people who love being part of a diverse, global team – and who get excited about making a real-world impact with data. Job description What You Will Be Doing Hitachi Vantara is looking for a Data Analyst to join its Global Analytics & Decision Sciences (GADS) team. This is an entry-level opportunity designed for a recent undergraduate graduate or someone beginning a career in data, analytics, business intelligence, or decision sciences. The position follows a hybrid work model based in Norman, Oklahoma. As a Data Analyst, you will work with experienced analysts, business intelligence professionals, data scientists, and stakeholders. You will help explore business questions, prepare and analyze data, develop reports and visualizations, and communicate findings in a clear and meaningful way. You will gain exposure to how analytics supports multiple areas of the business, including Supply Chain, Finance, Sales, Product Management, Finance, and Pricing. This role is well suited for someone who enjoys solving problems, learning innovative technologies, working with data, and understanding how analytical work can improve business decisions and processes. Key Responsibilities and Expectations Work with business stakeholders and team members to understand business questions, document requirements, and clarify the intended outcome of an analysis or reporting request. Gather, organize, clean, and validate data from multiple sources in preparation for analysis and reporting. Use tools such as SQL, Python, Microsoft Excel, Power BI, and approved AI tools to explore data, perform analysis, automate routine work, and develop reports or visualizations. Support the development and maintenance of Power BI dashboards, reports, datasets, and supporting documentation. Perform exploratory and descriptive analysis to identify trends, patterns, outliers, and areas for further investigation. Assist with defining, calculating, and validating business metrics and key performance indicators. Conduct data-quality checks and help identify inconsistencies, missing information, or unexpected results. Communicate analytical findings through clear visualizations, concise written summaries, and presentations appropriate for business audiences. Support testing and validation of reports, analytical solutions, data transformations, and enhancements before release. Partner with experienced team members on analytics, business intelligence, data science, and process improvement projects. Document analytical methods, data sources, business definitions, assumptions, and recurring processes to support consistency and knowledge sharing. Participate in team reviews, training, and working sessions while developing an understanding of the organization’s data, processes, and analytical standards. Explore new analytical tools, techniques, and technologies and share relevant learnings with the team. Manage assigned tasks responsibly, communicate progress and potential issues, and incorporate feedback into the work. What You Bring to the Team Required Qualifications A recently completed or soon-to-be-completed bachelor's degree in Data Science, Business Analytics, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Finance, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or another quantitatively oriented field. Foundational experience using SQL to retrieve, combine, or analyze data through academic coursework, internships, research, employment, or personal projects. Foundational experience with at least one analytical programming language, preferably Python or R. Familiarity with data visualization or business intelligence tools such as Power BI or Tableau. Working knowledge of Microsoft Excel, including organizing, analyzing, and summarizing data. Basic understanding of analytical and AI concepts such as descriptive statistics, data validation, regression, classification, prompt design, model limitations, or responsible AI use. Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills, with an interest in understanding both the data and the business question behind it. Attention to detail and a commitment to producing accurate, consistent, and well-documented work. Ability to communicate clearly, ask thoughtful questions, and explain findings to technical and nontechnical audiences. Ability to work collaboratively with individuals from different functions, backgrounds, and levels of technical experience. Demonstrated curiosity, initiative, and willingness to learn unfamiliar business concepts, data sources, and technologies. Ability to organize assigned work, balance multiple priorities, and respond constructively to feedback. Experience Expectations Prior full-time professional analytics experience is not required. Relevant experience may come from: Internships or cooperative education assignments Undergraduate research or capstone projects Technical coursework or laboratory work Student organizations, analytics competitions, or hackathons Volunteer analytics projects Independent technical projects Part-time employment involving data, reporting, or process improvement Preferred Qualifications The following qualifications are helpful but are not required: Experience developing reports or dashboards in Power BI, Tableau, or a similar visualization tool. Exposure to data preparation, data modeling, dimensional modeling, or ETL concepts. Experience using Python libraries such as pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, or similar analytical libraries. Familiarity with relational databases, cloud data platforms, APIs, or version-control tools such as Git. Exposure to machine learning, predictive analytics, generative AI, or other emerging analytical technologies through coursework or projects. Experience presenting an analysis, technical project, or recommendation to a classroom, project team, student organization, or business audience. A portfolio, GitHub repository, capstone project, or other work sample demonstrating analytical thinking and technical curiosity. Experience collaborating on a team-based technical, academic, or business project. What Success Looks Like Learn about the team’s primary business areas, data sources, reporting standards, and development practices. Complete assigned analysis and reporting tasks with appropriate guidance. Demonstrate consistent attention to data quality and business definitions. title: Post Doc - AI/ML and Optimization
desc: At Johnson & Johnson, we believe health is everything. Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build a world where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured, where treatments are smarter and less invasive, and solutions are personal. Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow, and profoundly impact health for humanity. Learn more at jnj.com . As guided by Our Credo, Johnson & Johnson is responsible to our employees who work with us throughout the world. We provide an inclusive work environment where each person is considered as an individual. At Johnson & Johnson, we respect the diversity and dignity of our employees and recognize their merit. Job Function: Career Programs Job Sub Function: Post Doc – Data Analytics & Computational Sciences Job Category: Career Program All Job Posting Locations: Cambridge, Massachusetts, United States of America, Titusville, New Jersey, United States of America Job Description: About Innovative Medicine Our expertise in Innovative Medicine is informed and inspired by patients, whose insights fuel our science-based advancements. Visionaries like you work on teams that save lives by developing the medicines of tomorrow. Join us in developing treatments, finding cures, and pioneering the path from lab to life while championing patients every step of the way. Learn more at https://www.jnj.com/innovative-medicine J&J Innovative Medicine - Data, Data Science, and AI - Global Development (DDSAI GD) is recruiting a Postdoctoral Scientist - AI/ML and Optimization. The ideal candidate will apply machine learning (ML), generative AI (GenAI), and optimization techniques to develop computational solutions that support and enhance global clinical operations, including enrollment forecasting, cost estimation and optimization, and country and site selection. Key Responsibilities Conduct research, build, test, and improve ML, GenAI, optimization pipelines for clinical development and trial operations. Analyze, prepare, and leverage operational, RWD, and cost data to build ML models and optimization engines to 1) predict outcomes of interest, 2) highlight tradeoffs between competing trial objectives, 3) recommend optimal operational scenarios, and 4) generate actionable insights, enabling early intervention and risk management. Develop and evaluate LLM-enabled workflows for document extraction, protocol comparison, trial similarity assessment, data harmonization, clinical-concept interpretation, and eligibility-criteria assessment. Stochastic simulations to forecast operational and patient journey outcomes including enrollment and patient study completion. Design experiments and tailored evaluation metrics and frameworks to support validation, monitoring, data-quality, and responsible-AI practices. Contribute reusable code, data pipelines, documentation in collaboration with data scientists, engineers, and clinical-development partners. Communicate research findings, analytical methods, and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders and contribute to internal or external scientific dissemination. Required Qualifications A Ph.D. degree, completed or expected before the start date, in computer science, statistics, biostatistics, biomedical informatics, epidemiology, health economics, applied mathematics, engineering, or another quantitative discipline. Hands-on experience with multi-modal ML predictive modeling and stochastic simulations for time-series forecasting. Experience with GenAI and clinical LLMs for document parsing, clinical concept disambiguation, or harmonization. Experience building multi-objective optimization engines to navigate complex trade-offs using evolutionary algorithms, reinforcement learning, or mixed-integer linear programming. Proficiency with programming languages Python and SQL, Experience with python LLM tools (e.g., DSPy, LangChain), optimization tools (e.g., pymoo) and ML tools (e.g., Scikit-learn, XGBoost, Optuna, PyMc), Familiarity with clinical operational data, real world data, electronic health records and claims, and financial data. A record of scientific communication through publications, conference presentations, open-source contributions, or equivalent research outputs. Preferred Qualifications Experience with EHR, claims, registry, CTMS, EDC, or clinical-trial data and related privacy and data-quality practices. Experience in MLOps practices and tools (MLflow, Kedro); Git usage, CI/CD stacks (Jenkins, GitLab) DevOps tools. Johnson & Johnson

title: Quantitative Model Validation Analyst
desc: At U.S. Bank, we’re on a journey to do our best. Helping the customers and businesses we serve to make better and smarter financial decisions and enabling the communities we support to grow and succeed. We believe it takes all of us to bring our shared ambition to life, and each person is unique in their potential. A career with U.S. Bank gives you a wide, ever-growing range of opportunities to discover what makes you thrive at every stage of your career. Try new things, learn new skills and discover what you excel at—all from Day One. Job Description Performs independent validation of market risk and capital markets models used in trading, valuation, risk measurement, and regulatory capital calculations. Models may include VaR, counterparty credit risk, xVA, stress testing models, pricing and valuation models, sensitivities/Greeks, curve construction, and related risk analytics. Executes validation activities across the model lifecycle, including: • Conceptual soundness reviews referencing financial theory and market practice • Quantitative testing (benchmarking, sensitivity analysis, back testing, stress testing, outcomes analysis) • Model implementation and controls review • Evaluation of ongoing model performance and monitoring processes • Identification and tracking of model limitations, compensating controls, and overlays Produces clear, well-structured model validation documentation aligned with internal standards and regulatory expectations. Deliverables include validation reports, presentations, test results, code documentation, monitoring report reviews, and related procedures. Works closely with model developers, risk managers, and governance teams while maintaining independent challenge and escalation of material model risks. Supports responses to regulatory exams, internal audit, and supervisory findings. Basic Qualifications - Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field, and five or more years of relevant experience OR - MA/MS in a quantitative field, and three or more years of related experience OR - PhD in a quantitative field, and less than two years of related experience Preferred Skills/Experience • Strong foundational knowledge of market risk and capital markets concepts, including derivatives, pricing, and risk measurement • Experience with statistical and quantitative modeling techniques (regression, time series analysis, simulation, parametric/non parametric methods) • Familiarity with model validation methodologies and regulatory expectations (SR 26-2, OCC 2026-13) • Proficiency in Python or similar statistical/programming tools used for validation and testing • Understanding of financial products and trading strategies across one or more asset classes • Ability to manage multiple tasks across various timelines • Strong analytical, organizational, problem-solving, negotiation, and project management skills • Demonstrated independence, teamwork and leadership skills • Effective interpersonal, verbal and written communication skills • Preference given to applicants with derivative pricing methods and quantitative risk management experience LOCATION EXPECTATIONS: This role requires working from a U.S. Bank Location three (3) or more days per week. If there’s anything we can do to accommodate a disability during any portion of the application or hiring process, please refer to our disability accommodations for applicants . Benefits: Our approach to benefits and total rewards considers our team members’ whole selves and what may be needed to thrive in and outside work. That's why our benefits are designed to help you and your family boost your health, protect your financial security and give you peace of mind. Our benefits include the following: Healthcare (medical, dental, vision) Basic term and optional term life insurance Short-term and long-term disability Pregnancy disability and parental leave 401(k) and employer-funded retirement plan Paid vacation (from two to five weeks depending on salary grade and tenure) Up to 11 paid holiday opportunities Adoption assistance Sick and Safe Leave accruals of one hour for every 30 worked, up to 80 hours per calendar year unless otherwise provided by law Review our full benefits available by employment status here . U.S. Bank

desc:
Wells Fargo Credit Cards is on an ambitious journey to build a best-in-class organization, and Business Analysts will play a central role in shaping the strategy and future direction of the business. As part of our transformation, you'll work at the intersection of business strategy, product, marketing, credit, risk, analytics, operations, and customer experience to solve complex business problems, identify growth opportunities, and develop data-driven strategies that deliver business value. Our vision is to develop versatile, multi-skilled leaders who can think strategically, analyze business performance, evaluate P&L impacts, and translate insights into actionable strategies. Join us for a unique opportunity to help shape the future of the Branded Cards business, drive meaningful business outcomes, and build a strong foundation for long-term career growth. In this role, you will: Exercise independent judgment and problem solving to deliver complex profit and loss (P&L) initiatives related to business product and customer performance, marketing outcomes, or operational efficiency while demonstrating ownership of deliverables to support ideation, design, execution, and measurement Contribute to business cases across multiple domains including marketing acquisition, credit risk, and analytics by translating product and customer growth strategy into clear analysis plans and by evaluating credit risk, operational impacts, and return on investment trade-offs Frame complex and ambiguous business problems, combining product and customer insights, and develop recommendations based on data modeling using hypothesis-driven approaches Build queries, models, and dashboards to analyze and display data for decision discussions Develop an understanding of how product variables and features impact customer conversion and go-to-market Monitor post-launch performance and identify and document emerging risks by analyzing performance data, customer behavior, and marketing results Collaborate and consult with a variety of stakeholders including marketing acquisition, finance, analytics, risk, product delivery, technology, and operations Required Qualifications 2+ years of business analysis, strategy, product, marketing, finance, credit risk, or related analysis experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education Desired Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Statistics, Analytics, Mathematics, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field. Experience leveraging SQL, Python, Excel, Tableau, Power BI, or similar tools to extract, analyze, model, visualize, and communicate data-driven insights. Strong analytical, business analysis, and structured problem-solving skills with the ability to translate complex business challenges into actionable recommendations. Experience analyzing credit cards, consumer lending, payments, banking, fintech, or financial services portfolios to identify trends, risks, growth opportunities, and performance drivers. Demonstrated ability to apply strategic thinking and data-driven decision-making to improve customer, portfolio, product, and business outcomes. Knowledge of customer acquisition, engagement, retention, portfolio management, credit risk, fraud, marketing analytics, or related cards business functions. Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to develop business cases, present findings, tell compelling data-driven stories, and influence stakeholders at all levels. Experience conducting customer, market, competitive, and portfolio analysis to support strategic business decisions and growth initiatives. Proven ability to partner effectively with cross-functional teams and business leaders to drive strategic initiatives, process improvements, and measurable business results. Demonstrated intellectual curiosity, adaptability, and the ability to thrive in fast-paced, ambiguous environments while managing multiple priorities. Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across teams and stakeholders. Consulting, strategy, business transformation, or financial services analytics experience preferred. title: AI Engineer
desc: CCC Intelligent Solutions Inc. (CCC) is a leading cloud platform for the multi-trillion-dollar insurance economy , creating intelligent experiences for insurers, repairers, automakers, part suppliers, and more. At CCC, we’re making life just work by empowering more than 35,000 businesses with industry-leading technology to get drivers back on the road and to health quickly and seamlessly. We’re pushing boundaries with innovative AI solutions that simplify and enhance the claims and repair journey. Through purposeful innovation and the strength of its connections, CCC technologies empower the people and industry relied upon to keep lives moving forward when it matters most. Learn more about CCC at www.cccis.com . The Role CCC Intelligent Solutions Inc. (CCC) is a leading cloud platform for the multi-trillion-dollar insurance economy, creating intelligent experiences for insurers, repairers, automakers, part suppliers, and more. At CCC, we’re making life just work by empowering more than 35,000 businesses with industry-leading technology to get drivers back on the road and to health quickly and seamlessly. We’re pushing boundaries with innovative AI solutions that simplify and enhance the claims and repair journey. Through purposeful innovation and the strength of its connections, CCC technologies empower the people and industry relied upon to keep lives moving forward when it matters most. Learn more about CCC at www.cccis.com. The Role: You will build and ship LLM-powered features and agentic workflows for our customers. These features automate the routine parts of a claim and guide customers on the rest, so they have to earn that trust with measured accuracy, not a convincing demo. Agents run as steps inside deterministic workflows, and privacy and security are design baselines, not review gates. Agentic coding tools are how you move fast. What you add is what they are worst at: system design, security, and hard debugging. You own features end to end. Key Responsibilities: Ship LLM-powered features and agentic workflows in Python and TypeScript, from a problem scoped with product managers and data scientists through production traffic, and help set the metrics you will be measured against. Write the evals, guardrails, and feedback loops that make your features trustworthy, and hold them to explicit token and latency budgets. Use agentic coding tools every day, and own the review of what they produce: catch the correctness, security, and design problems in generated code before you open the pull request. Maintain and extend the NLP pipelines that turn unstructured claim data into structured data customers can act on, blending semantic search, classical NLP, and LLMs. Build and operate durable, event-driven services in which agents run as steps inside deterministic workflows, with checkpointed model outputs so a retry does not re-invoke a completed LLM step. Trace every model call and agent step so a recommendation can be reconstructed and audited, with citations back to the source documents, and wire that tracing into your alerts. Model and query claims data across relational, document, and graph stores. Design privacy and security in from the start: tenant isolation, least-privilege access for agents and their tools, and a clear rule for what data may reach a model provider. Write a technical design document before any significant change, and use it to get feedback and buy-in from the team before you build. Take part in a shared on-call rotation for the services you build. Requirements: 3+ years of professional software engineering experience, including at least one LLM-powered feature you shipped and then operated in production. Python and TypeScript: typed, tested, async code in both, and real depth in one. Evals you have designed for LLM output, plus guardrails you have shipped. A clear account of how you constrain an agentic coding tool's context and verify its output, from daily use of Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar on production work. Pipelines that blend LLMs with semantic search and classical NLP: structured output, tool calling, embedding-based retrieval, and a case where a classical technique beat an LLM. Services built on message- or event-driven architectures, including long-running workflows with retries, idempotent handlers, and event-sourced state, plus an LLM or agent step you ran inside one. Data modeling and development across relational, document, and graph databases such as PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and Neo4j, including when each type fits and the partition-key, consistency, and tenant-isolation calls you made. Backend services built and operated on Azure or AWS, and exposure to a durable workflow engine such as Temporal or the Durable Task Scheduler. Technical design documents you have written to get feedback and buy-in from a team before building, and that the team then built to. Clear writing and discussion for technical and non-technical audiences, and code review you can give as well as take. Even Better if You Have: React and TypeScript experience, so you can deliver a full-stack feature end to end. Chat, streaming, and citation-heavy AI experiences especially. Experience with CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure as code such as Terraform or Bicep. Experience with agent frameworks, LangGraph and the Microsoft Agent Framework among them, and with the ways agents reach their tools: the Model Context Protocol (MCP), the Agent2Agent (A2A) protocol, command-line tools, and microservices. Experience with LLM observability and evaluation tooling such as LangSmith, Arize, or Braintrust, and with OpenTelemetry-based tracing. Experience designing A/B tests for AI features, or what-if simulations that replay historical claims through a proposed change before it ships. Exposure to the insurance, claims, or automotive repair domains. What Success Looks Like: In your first six months you ship an LLM-powered feature, its evals run in CI, and you can name the metric it moved. When a model migration or prompt change causes a regression, the evals you wrote catch it before a customer does. You take ownership from concept to production with light direction, asking the right questions early. You care that things hold up: the services you build survive retries, partial failures, and model migrations without incidents a customer can see. When something goes wrong in production, the trace tells you which step and which model call, and you can show an auditor the same thing. Privacy and security reviews of your features find nothing that was not already designed in. You enjoy the craft, and it shows: engineers pick up your patterns without being told to. You enjoy the back-and-forth that gets a feature scoped, and you can argue a position without needing to win it. You embrace our ambitious, collaborative, and empathetic values, and you like problems where the answer has to be measured rather than argued. title: Research Scientist – Patient-Centered Outcomes & In-Trial Research
desc: Work Schedule Standard (Mon-Fri) Environmental Conditions Office Job Description Join Us as a Research Scientist– Make an Impact at the Forefront of Innovation Team: In-trial research team within the Patient-Centered Research group Location: North America or Europe Patient-Centered Research, In-trial qualitative research Evidera’s Patient-Centered Research (PCR) group combines a unique portfolio of scientific disciplines, including health sciences, psychometrics, epidemiology, psychology, and many other social sciences. Our PCR staff conduct a variety of studies using quantitative and qualitative approaches to develop clinical outcomes assessments, evaluate patient preferences and utilities, execute various implementation science studies, conduct Delphi panels and do secondary data analysis using advanced statistical techniques. Within the PCR group, the ITR team conduct qualitative (interviews) studies and/or surveys in the context of a clinical trial to obtain feedback from clinical trial participants (patient, caregiver, investigator or study staff) on various topics i.e., understanding patients’ experience with their condition, its impacts on their lives, exploring treatment benefit, describing trial participant experiences and identifying aspects of burden from their participation. ITR can be implemented using an embedded design (e.g., ITR is defined as clinical trial activity in the clinical trial study protocol and ICF) or associated design (ITR is covered under separate protocol, separate ICF, and IRB/EC approval, with separate site recruitment and contracting). ITR can be conducted at any trial phase and at any time in the trial (screening, mid-trial, exit). Over the past few years, there has been a growing interest in ITR studies by regulators to support relevance and interpretation of trial outcomes, meaningful change and/or meaningful treatment benefit. Position Overview: The ITR Research Scientist is the independent Principal Investigator of projects responsible for overseeing all aspects of project delivery; delegates project management tasks to more junior scientific staff. Takes scientific responsibility for project completion; responsible for strategic consultation and for use of best methods to address research needs. Able to oversee and participate in a large project portfolio. Innovates scientifically and produces output of high scientific quality. Assumes significant responsibilities for sales targets and client development. Essential Duties and Responsibilities (other duties may be assigned): Science Applies in-depth knowledge of scientific methods, mainly qualitative but also quantitative. Presents scientific work in peer-reviewed journals and at professional meetings. Provides scientific leadership to team members. Produces deliverables of high scientific quality. Advises and implements best methods and scientific innovation in project plans and design. Highly productive in terms of number and volume of scientific projects responsible for, involved with, and consulting on. Knowledge of regulatory requirements and guidelines. Scientific contributions may include: Development and delivery of scientific studies and results directly to clients. Assisting colleagues to optimize study design and implementation when scientist has specific areas of expertise. Non-project related publications, presentations, workshops, advisory boards, participation in FDA meetings, etc. Strategy/Consulting Develops and maintains client relationships. Understands pharmaceutical industry/FDA structure. Identifies scientific methods/plans that help clients meet their goals as well as those that will not help clients meet their goals. Provides scientifically rigorous deliverables that best help clients meet their objectives. Helps clients prepare for regulatory meetings and attend regulatory meetings with clients as requested. Financial & Business Development Brings in proposal leads. Writes proposals and managing proposal writing process. Closes sales. Meets annual target utilization rate of 60%, unless otherwise specified. Project Management Manages internal timelines to ensure that deliverables meet external client timelines. Manages internal budget/staff hours per project not to exceed contracted budget. Manages scope creep or out of scope work. Manages legal/contracting issues. PCR Operations Support Develops and presents internal scientific trainings. Conforms to SOPs and other Evidera/PPD requirements. Actively supports new product development and scientific innovation. Hiring requirements: Education requirements Doctorate in a life sciences or social sciences discipline (psychology, epidemiology, health services, public health, etc…) and more than 3 years’ experience in relevant field Master’s degree in a life sciences or social sciences discipline (psychology, epidemiology, health services, public health, etc…) and more than 5-7 years’ experience in relevant field In some cases, an equivalency, consisting of a combination of appropriate education, training and/or directly related experience, will be considered sufficient for an individual to meet the requirements of the role. Experienced requirements: Experience using Computer-Assisted Qualitative Data Analysis Software (CAQDAS), such as Atlas.ti, NVivo, MAXQDA, Dedoose, etc. is required Experience analyzing patient experience data is required, such as interviews, surveys, COA (clinical outcome assessment). Experience managing multiple projects is required. Experience in pharma or consulting companies is preferred. Familiarity working in a clinical research environment is preferred. Personal Skills & Competencies: Deep understanding of qualitative research principles and familiarity with the conduct of qualitative research in the context of clinical trials Extensive knowledge of qualitative methods Advanced level understanding of operational and logistical challenges of ITR Well-developed communication skills and scientific writing skills Demonstrates strong analytical and problem-solving skills Demonstrates ability to independently manage, oversee, and/or lead a variety of project-related tasks and effectively delegates tasks to project team Demonstrates ability to manage client relationships Collaborative team member, capable of efficient multi-tasking Why join us? When you join Thermo Fisher Scientific, you become part of a global team that values passion, innovation, and a commitment to scientific excellence. You’ll work in an environment where collaboration and development are part of the everyday experience—and where your contributions truly make a difference. Apply today to help us deliver tomorrow’s breakthroughs.

Demonstrated ability to lead through influence, effectively navigating and prioritizing complex cross-departmental projects to drive impactful change. title: Business Analyst
desc: About Morningstar and the Individual Investor Business Morningstar’s Individual Investor business empowers investors with data, research, and tools to help them make informed financial decisions. Our flagship Morningstar Investor platform provides deep insights, portfolio tracking, and investment research, while Morningstar.com serves as a hub for market news, analysis, and educational content. *NOTE: We’re not considering candidates who require sponsorship now or in the future. The Role We are seeking a Business Data Analyst to bring analytical rigor to our product efforts. The role will help us measure performance, analyze visitor and subscriber behavior, and optimize customer acquisition and retention efforts. This role will own data analytics architecture, reporting, forecasting models, user behavior analysis, and work cross-functionally to enhance our product and marketing strategies. You will be responsible for building and tracking KPIs across Morningstar Investor, Morningstar.com, and our broader suite of investor products, implementing analytics solutions, and driving insights that support strategic decision-making. This role will report to the Head of Revenue and will partner with the engineering team to ensure seamless tracking and reporting. Key Responsibilities Data Analytics & Reporting • Track and analyze daily, weekly, monthly, and yearly KPIs to measure the product’s effectiveness and progress toward growth goals. • Build, maintain and continuously evolve dashboards that monitor trials, subscriber growth, page views, engagement, and on-site behavior across Morningstar Investor and Morningstar.com to meet the needs of the product. • Consolidate data from various sources such as Google suite, Redshift, Stripe, and AWS to create automated reporting solutions that provide actionable insights. • Collaborate with the engineering team to design solutions to better surface and analyze these insights. • Monitor and validate data from third-party sources to ensure accuracy and reliability. • Define baseline targets and use data-driven insights to optimize acquisition, engagement, and retention strategies. • Conduct cohort analysis, customer lifetime value (LTV) modeling, and retention analysis to inform product investment decisions. Forecasting & Financial Modeling • Develop and maintain financial forecasting models to project revenue growth and subscription trends over the next three years based on historical data and market assumptions. • Evaluate the impact of pricing, marketing spend, and customer acquisition efforts on financial performance. Data Infrastructure & Collaboration • Work with engineering and data teams to build and maintain a centralized data infrastructure that supports product analytics. • Define and implement data tracking solutions using Google Tag Manager (GTM) and SQL-based data pipelines. Solid understanding of data warehouse or lakehouse concepts, distributed processing fundamentals, and Linux basics. title: AI/ML Imaging Data Scientist
desc: AI/ML Imaging Data Scientist Department Summary This role is based in the Digital Endpoints and Patient-Centered Solutions (DEPCS) team, the innovative digital, AI, and tech function within Roche Product Development Data Sciences (PDD). Operating across the Science of Medicines and Operations, DEPCS is responsible for embedding patient-centered and AI-enabled digital solutions into the fabric of clinical research. By integrating data science, measurement science, and digital product thinking, DEPCS delivers scalable and regulatory-ready innovations that enhance trial design, evidence generation, and clinical value of Roche medicines. This position is based in South San Francisco, on site . The Opportunity The AI/ML Imaging Data Scientist within the Digital Endpoints and Patient-Centered Solutions (DEPCS) function is responsible for designing, building, and deploying machine learning image analysis solutions to enhance clinical trials and accelerate data-driven decision-making in drug development. Collaborating across clinical, imaging, data science, and engineering teams, the role contributes to the development of multimodal AI solutions, particularly in imaging and unstructured data, to drive Roche’s patient-centered and AI-enabled innovation agenda. You design, develop, and deploy AI-based solutions to enhance clinical trial design, conduct, interpretation, and probability of success, from early to late-stage drug development. You design and implement advanced image analysis applications. These algorithms are based on standard image analysis techniques, vision foundation models and machine learning algorithms tailored to clinical trial data, in a range of disease areas, including oncology, neuroscience, and ophthalmology, ensuring best AI/ML model development practices. You collaborate cross-functionally, including with clinicians, biostatisticians, imaging experts, MLOps and other data scientists, to integrate machine learning models into Roche platforms and clinical workflows. You analyze complex imaging, biological, and clinical data to generate insights supporting decision-making in clinical development. You will work closely with the MLOps and clinical imaging data management groups to deploy, maintain and integrate computational solutions. You will utilize and build on your experience in scientific/medical imaging, data and image management, application of novel statistical and machine learning approaches to large unstructured data, software development, and scientific data transfers. You present technical insights to both scientific and non-technical audiences. You contribute to the publication of findings and to internal knowledge development efforts. You maintain awareness of trends in AI/ML, imaging and digital biomarkers, and clinical AI. Who you are You hold an MSc or PhD (preferred) in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Electrical Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, or a related field. You have 2+ years of post-graduate experience in machine learning, data science, or AI in medical imaging applications within biomedical, pharma, or healthcare innovation settings. You bring excellent communication, problem-solving, and teamwork skills, with a track record of delivering innovative machine learning solutions aligned with business needs, and the ability to work independently as well as in a cross-functional team. You have expertise in image analysis, pattern recognition, machine learning, computer vision, Large Language Models/Foundation Models, data mining, statistics, and probabilistic modeling. You are proficient with scientific programming languages and familiar with high-performance computing infrastructure, machine learning experiment monitoring workflows and modern AI-assisted development tools. Preferred skills include Python, Git, GitLab, Docker, shell scripting, and Slurm/LSF. You have expertise in applying rigorous AI/ML development practices, including appropriate train/validation/test design, leakage prevention, robust benchmarking, uncertainty and error analysis, external validation, experiment tracking, reproducible pipelines. You demonstrate capacity for independent thinking and ability to make decisions based upon sound principles. You bring excellent strategic agility including problem-solving and critical thinking skills, and agility that extends beyond the technical domain. You demonstrate respect for cultural differences when interacting with colleagues in the global workplace. Preferred Experience developing or validating ML models for regulated environments or real-world datasets. Contributions to scientific publications or open-source projects in healthcare AI. title: Data Engineers
desc: Job Description The future of money is being built right now. At FIS, we help the world’s businesses, banks and communities move, manage and grow money with confidence. Join a team that values fresh thinking, works together to solve complex challenges, and creates technology that powers everyday life. About the role As a Data Engineer, AI Governance , you will design, build, and maintain the data foundations that support responsible, trusted, and scalable AI across FIS. This role combines deep backend engineering expertise with a passion for data quality, governance, and transparency. You will serve as a data wrangler and problem solver, ensuring data is discoverable, traceable, reliable, and fit for purpose while providing visibility into data lineage, ownership, and usage throughout the enterprise. Your key responsibilities Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend data pipelines, integrations, and data platforms that support AI governance and analytics initiatives. Consolidate and transform data from multiple enterprise sources into trusted, governed datasets for AI and business consumption. Establish and maintain end-to-end data lineage, enabling visibility into where data originates, how it is transformed, and how it is consumed. Partner with business, technology, and governance teams to define data ownership, stewardship, and accountability models. Implement data quality controls, monitoring frameworks, and observability practices to proactively identify and resolve data issues. Develop metadata management processes that improve data discoverability, traceability, and governance compliance. Support data access governance by helping define, automate, and monitor data access controls and permissions. Build and maintain data validation, reconciliation, and audit capabilities that improve trust in enterprise data assets. Collaborate with AI, machine learning, and analytics teams to ensure governed data is available for model development and operational use cases. Recommend and implement automation opportunities that improve data reliability, efficiency, and operational excellence. What you bring Required qualifications Experience as a Data Engineer, Data Platform Engineer, Data Integration Engineer, or similar role supporting large-scale data environments. Strong experience building and supporting backend data pipelines using modern data engineering practices. Experience with data integration, transformation, cleansing, and consolidation across multiple data sources. Strong understanding of data governance, data quality, metadata management, and data lifecycle management. Experience establishing and documenting data lineage, data flows, and data dependencies. Proficiency with SQL and data modeling concepts in enterprise data environments. Experience with cloud-based data platforms, data warehouses, and data lake architectures. Knowledge of data security, access management, and governance principles. Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills with exceptional attention to detail. Passion for creating high-quality, trusted, and well-governed data products. Preferred qualifications Experience supporting AI, machine learning, or responsible AI governance programs. Familiarity with data catalog, metadata management, data lineage, or data observability platforms. Experience implementing enterprise data quality and monitoring frameworks. Experience within financial services, fintech, payments, banking, or highly regulated industries. The impact you’ll make As a Data Engineer, AI Governance , you will help establish confidence in the data that powers AI and business decision-making across FIS. Your work will enable clear visibility into data origins, transformations, ownership, and consumption while ensuring high standards of quality, accessibility, and governance. By building trusted data foundations, you will play a critical role in advancing responsible AI adoption and delivering scalable solutions that create long-term value for the organization. What we offer you Bring your ideas. Build your future. At FIS, you'll find the support, resources and opportunities to develop your career while helping shape the future of financial technology. title: Research Professional
desc: Department BSD BMB - Rice Lab About the Department The Department of Biochemistry and Molecular Biology studies how biomolecules function and interact to drive the complex, diverse, and adaptive behaviors of living systems. Our focus is on biological mechanisms described at the atomic level. We are highly collaborative and often employ multiple approaches to address otherwise intractable questions. We have particular strengths in membrane proteins and RNA biochemistry and are pioneers in all areas of biophysics, structural biology, biochemistry, and protein engineering and design. Job Summary The job performs routine assignments that facilitate and promote a research project or contributes to the scientific direction of a research resource. Receives instruction, guidance, and direction from others. The Rice Lab focuses on the structural biology, biochemistry, mechanism, and biology of microbial mobile genetic elements and the machinery that they encode. The Lab is highly interdisciplinary and team members must be able to work effectively and collegially in a team environment. The projects require expertise in cryo electron microscopy (single particle analysis), biochemical analysis of recombinase function, bio-informatics and the ability to converse intellectually with team members undertaking related projects using diverse tools, including microbiology. Responsibilities Performs experiments and collects and analyzes data. Participates in the promotion of a research project. Participates in the preparation and writing of grant applications and reports, and co-authors/authors scientific research manuscripts. Provides peer review of grant applications and scientific manuscripts. Collaborates on development of new research projects with academic and community-based organizations. Performs other related work as needed. Minimum Qualifications Education: Minimum requirements include a PhD in related field. Work Experience: Minimum requirements include knowledge and skills developed through Certifications: --- Preferred Qualifications Experience: Cryo electron microscopy. Protein purification. Biochemistry of protein-DNA interactions and DNA recombinases. Structural-biology related bioinformatics. Peer-reviewed publications in a related field. Preferred Competencies Ability to maintain calm and courteous demeanor and to work productively despite heavy workload, competing priorities and complex problems. Willingness to help others in the lab as needed. Excellent problem-solving skills. Initiative in identifying new tools and software that are useful to the lab. Background knowledge of microbial mobile genetic elements and the mechanisms of the recombinases they encode. Working Conditions Research Lab setting.
